name: Pest control

problems.words: Clients ask for service reports for audits and we can't find them
quick_ideas: Ask technicians to photograph each report and send it to one office number, so nothing stays in a van
File them per client by month.

workzap_build.text: Digital service reports created on the technician's phone, sent to the client instantly and stored for audits, with a monthly audit pack per business client.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many business clients are on regular contracts?
problems.free_stops: Report fields and pack layout are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many recent service reports take longer than a short search to find, so audit delays are easy to size.
Make one cupboard shelf or drawer the only place for finished service reports, so audit requests are answered without rummaging.

problems.words: Follow-up visits included in the price are forgotten
quick_ideas: Book the follow-up date at the time of the first visit, so it's never left to memory
Check upcoming follow-ups each Monday.

workzap_build.text: A job scheduler that sets up the follow-up visit for every treatment that includes one.

problems.ask_first: How are follow-up visits scheduled today?
problems.free_stops: Scheduling rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many included follow-up visits were due this week but are still unbooked, so missed prepaid work is easy to spot.
Give one staff member the job of checking one follow-up list every morning, so included visits get booked before customers chase.

problems.words: AMC visits are missed and the restaurant fails its inspection
quick_ideas: List every AMC client's next visit date in one calendar
Confirm each visit with the client the day before.

workzap_build.text: An AMC register with a visit calendar, missed-visit alerts and renewal reminders.

problems.ask_first: How do you keep track of visit dates now?
problems.free_stops: Alert timing and the register design are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare planned AMC visits with visits actually completed this week for each restaurant type, so missed inspection-critical calls stand out early.
Assign one person to hand tomorrow’s AMC visit list to technicians each evening, so restaurant visits stop being missed.

problems.words: Customers call saying the cockroaches are back a week later
quick_ideas: Log every re-treatment with its likely cause
Review the list monthly to see which jobs repeat.

workzap_build.text: A re-treatment tracker with cause and cost, to show repeat-complaint patterns by service and technician.

problems.ask_first: How are re-treatments handled and charged?
problems.free_stops: Cause categories are in the solution document; treatment choices stay with the licensed technician.

extra_ideas.text: Count repeat call-backs by job type from the past week, so you can see where return visits are eating time.
Keep one notebook for every call-back and let one supervisor review it each Friday, so repeat jobs get discussed from facts.

problems.words: Chemical stock goes down faster than the jobs justify
quick_ideas: Record what each technician is issued and what they return
Compare issues against jobs done once.

workzap_build.text: A product register with issue per technician and usage against completed jobs.

problems.ask_first: How are products issued to technicians?
problems.free_stops: Usage benchmarks are in the solution document; dosage stays with the label and technician.

extra_ideas.text: Compare what leaves the store each week with how many jobs were completed, so unusual stock drop gets noticed quickly.
Make one storekeeper note every issue and return in one notebook at handover time, so stock movement stops being argued about.

problems.words: Technicians quote different prices for the same job
quick_ideas: Give everyone one fixed price list by service and property size
Ask them to call the office before any change.

workzap_build.text: You would see technicians working from one fixed price list on their phones, with any change on site needing the office's sign-off.

problems.ask_first: Who decides the price on site?
problems.free_stops: Price list structure and approval limits are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare quotes given this week for similar job sizes, so price differences show up before customers start comparing.
Choose one office person to confirm any nonstandard quote before it is promised, so technicians stop giving mixed prices.

problems.words: AMC renewals lapse because nobody reminds the client
quick_ideas: List AMCs by end date
Call those ending in the next couple of months.

workzap_build.text: Renewal reminders sent ahead of every AMC end date.

problems.ask_first: How many AMC clients do you have?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many AMC renewals end this month without any reminder noted, so the renewal leak is clear.
Keep one renewal diary checked at the same time each week by one person, so expiring AMCs get chased in time.

problems.words: Calls come into one phone and get missed in summer
quick_ideas: Add a WhatsApp booking option, so calls aren't the only way in
Call back missed numbers at fixed times.

workzap_build.text: A WhatsApp booking flow capturing pest type, property type, area and preferred slot.

problems.ask_first: How do customers book a treatment?
problems.free_stops: Booking flow design is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count missed calls by time of day during hot weeks, so you can see when the single phone falls behind.
Set fixed callback times and give one person the missed-call notebook, so summer demand gets answered more consistently.

problems.words: Restaurants pay their AMC invoices very late
quick_ideas: List unpaid invoices by age
Send invoices with the service report, so proof travels with the bill.

workzap_build.text: Receivables tracking with reminders for every business client.

problems.ask_first: Which clients cause the most delays?
problems.free_stops: Reminder schedule is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each restaurant AMC invoice beside the service date and sent date, so delays between job completion and billing stand out.
Give one staff member one weekly time to send every pending restaurant AMC invoice from one notebook list, so billing goes out consistently.

problems.words: Company licence and technician certifications sneak up
quick_ideas: Put every licence and certification expiry in one calendar
Give one person ownership.

workzap_build.text: A licence and certification expiry calendar with alerts.

problems.ask_first: Who keeps track of expiry dates?
problems.free_stops: Alert timing is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many licences and certifications expire within the same season, so the renewal rush is clear before work gets disrupted.
Keep one paper list of all expiry dates with one office person updating it every Friday, so renewals stop sneaking up.

never_say: Any product, dosage, dilution, application method, re-entry time or safety precaution; the licensed technician and label decide.
Any answer to health questions like "is it safe for my baby"; the business needs consistent approved guidance.
Any help using banned or unlabelled chemicals, diluting product, faking reports or working without a licence.
Any recording of customers' names, addresses or numbers, or technicians' personal details.
Anything other than emergency services, the poison centre or a vet first for suspected poisoning or exposure.

sample_reply.person: Is there a better way to handle service reports? Restaurants need them for inspections and ours are handwritten and half go missing.
sample_reply.pi:
Yes, there is a way through this, and none of it needs special equipment.
First, ask technicians to photograph each report and send it to one office number, so nothing stays in a van.
Second, file those by client and month, so any report can be found in minutes.
The next step up would be: digital reports made on the technician's phone, sent to the client instantly and stored as an audit pack.

Shall I prepare a solution document and quote for you? You're welcome to say no.
